author: Google
description:
Filmmaker https://www.youtube.com/@Oner_Biberkoku shares his "screenshot strategy" for building a full narrative from a single starting point during this In the Flow interview. Thanks Oner for the partnership!

"At the end of the shot, you can take a screenshot, give it again [to Flow], and you now have a new image of that character in a different situation... So I think, with one image, you can stay in the flow, and make a story."

Try Flow for yourself: https://flow.google  
Learn how to create in Flow: https://youtu.be/9nVEfjmDlVk?si=DKlab6LdBgjaOCX4
